heroParagraph: Objective evaluations with the SCA cupping protocol: every coffee is cupped blind by specialists and only marked as verified when the consensus backs it.
listErrorMessage: The verified offerings could not be loaded.
aboutStoryText: A label promises origin, process and quality, but only the cup can confirm it. Tazavera exists to close that gap: a guide built on objective evaluations, with the SCA cupping protocol, so that what is verified says what is in every cup.
aboutStepProvisional: The coffeeshop registers its offering as provisional: origin, roaster and lot, before any evaluation.
aboutStepCupping: Specialists cup it blind with the SCA cupping protocol and record their score.
aboutStepConsensus: The consensus of the evaluations decides: only what several cuppings back earns the verified mark.
aboutAudienceText: Tazavera is for coffeeshops that want to show with evidence what they serve, and for specialists who want to evaluate it with rigor.
metaDescription: Tazavera, the guide to good coffee: objective evaluations with the SCA cupping protocol that discover what is in every cup.
